title: R' Nehilai bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He spoke in the name of Shmuel in [Taanit 6a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.6a.6) and in Yoma 22a, as cited by Hyman. The latter passage is at [Yoma 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.22b.7).[^1]

notes.text: Taanit concerns the late rain and Yoma the appointment of a public leader. Both consulted passages give the full transmission “Rav Nehilai bar Idi said in the name of Shmuel.” [Heilprin’s Nehilai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2609&lang=en) points to his Chanilai entry.
